title: 声母和韵母
intro: A Mandarin syllable = initial (声母) + final (韵母) + tone. This unit drills the contrasts English speakers blur: aspirated vs plain (b/p, d/t, g/k, j/q, zh/ch, z/c), retroflex vs flat (zh ch sh vs z c s vs j q x), n vs l, f vs h, -n vs -ng, u vs ü. Open the pinyin chart under More to hear every syllable in all four tones.

items.en: bag; to wrap · b: no puff of air
to toss · p: strong puff of air
south · n: air through the nose
blue · l: air around the tongue
to fly · f: teeth on lip
grey; ash · h: from the throat, rougher than English h
chicken · j: tongue flat, no puff
west · x: tongue flat, lips spread
poem · sh: tongue tip curled back
purple · z: tongue behind the teeth, like 'ds'
word · c: like 'ts' with a puff
hot · r: like English r with a light buzz
capital (北京) · -ng: back of the tongue, as in 'sing'
green · ü: say 'ee' with rounded lips
hungry · e: like the 'u' in 'duh', from the back of the mouth

texts.title: 四是四（绕口令）

lines.p: shéi shuō shí sì shì sì shí
shéi shuō sì shí shì shí sì

notes: The whole twister trains s (tongue behind the teeth) against sh (tongue curled back), plus tone 4 sì against tone 2 shí.
Many southern speakers merge sh into s. Northern standard Mandarin keeps them apart.

qs.q: 「四十」的「四」和「十」分别是第几声？

texts.title: 吃葡萄（绕口令）

lines.p: chī pú tao bù tǔ pú tao pí
lines.en: Eat grapes without spitting out grape skins,

lines.p: bù chī pú tao dào tǔ pú tao pí
lines.en: don't eat grapes yet spit out grape skins.

notes: p with a puff (葡 pú, 皮 pí) against t with a puff (吐 tǔ) and plain d (倒 dào).
倒 dào here means 'contrary to expectation'.

texts.title: 门口有四辆四轮大马车（绕口令）

lines.zh: 门口有四辆四轮大马车，
lines.p: mén kǒu yǒu sì liàng sì lún dà mǎ chē
lines.en: At the gate there are four big four-wheeled horse carts,

lines.zh: 你爱拉哪两辆就拉哪两辆。
lines.p: nǐ ài lā nǎ liǎng liàng jiù lā nǎ liǎng liàng

notes: l against n, and liàng (辆, measure word for vehicles) against liǎng (两, two).
口有 kóu yǒu and 哪两 ná liǎng: 3+3 sandhi.

exercises.q: Which initial is said with a strong puff of air?
exercises.why: Pinyin b/p is not voiced/voiceless like English; it's unaspirated/aspirated. Hold a tissue in front of your mouth: p makes it flutter, b doesn't.

exercises.q: In ju, qu, xu, yu the u is really:
exercises.why: After j, q, x and y the two dots on ü are dropped in writing because plain u can never follow them.

exercises.q: In zhi, chi, shi, ri, zi, ci, si the -i is:
o: a buzzing continuation of the consonant, not 'ee'
exercises.why: Keep the tongue where the consonant was and just add voice. 是 shì is not 'shee'.

o: the tongue tip up behind the teeth
the back of the tongue raised, sound through the nose, as in 'sing'
exercises.why: -n: tip of the tongue (金 jīn). -ng: back of the tongue (京 jīng).

o: ch in 'cheap', tongue flat, lips spread
sh in 'sheep' with the tongue flat behind the lower teeth
exercises.why: x is between s and sh: smile and say 'see' with a hiss.
c = aspirated z. z (紫 zǐ) is 'ds' in 'beds'.

scenario.title: 公园里认识小朋友
scenario.setting: You're four. At the playground another kid comes over. Watch s vs sh in 四 sì / 十 shí.

a.p: nǐ hǎo nǐ jiào shén me míng zi

opts.p: wǒ jiào xiǎo míng nǐ ne
opts.fb: 我叫 + name, then bounce the question back with 你呢？
Fine for a kid, but 我叫小明 is the full answer.

b.p: wǒ jiào lè le nǐ jǐ suì
b.en: I'm Lele. How old are you?

opts.fb: 四 sì: tongue behind the teeth, falling tone.
Careful: 十 shí is ten. A four-year-old says 四 sì.

c.npc: 我也四岁！我们一起玩儿吧！
c.p: wǒ yě sì suì wǒ men yī qǐ wánr ba
c.en: I'm four too! Let's play together!

opts.p: hǎo a wǒ men wánr shén me
opts.fb: 玩儿 wánr with the northern r.

d.p: shí suì nǐ hǎo xiǎo a

opts.p: bù shì shí suì shì sì suì
opts.fb: Good repair. 不是 bú shì; then s vs sh.
